svg.aria-label: Share of each ticket's session-file reads that an earlier session on the same ticket had already made
svg.title: Share of each ticket's session-file reads that an earlier session on the same ticket had already made
svg.text: Re-finding: how much of what a session reads, an earlier session on the same ticket already read
277 tickets with two or more sessions whose first read was on or after 1 Sep, sorted by share. A read is a file in a repo, the ticket, a dispatch
item's feedback or the proxy instructions, counted once per session (a session-file pair). A pair repeats when an earlier session charged to the
same ticket had read the same thing. Charged to the ticket of the dispatch item being worked.

svg.text: Pooled: 51.9% of session-file reads and 58.2% of read tokens repeat an earlier session's. Those repeats are 5.6% of the context
these sessions carried (all their reads: 11.2%). Charged to the session's own ticket instead: 52% of pairs, median ticket 47.8%. Median 6 sessions a ticket.
